summary: Toronto-Dominion Bank filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report disclosing senior executive appointments effective September 4, 2026, announced September 3 via news release. Vlad Shpilsky becomes Group Head, Global Technology and Solutions; Renu Gupta becomes SEVP and Chief Strategy and Commercial Officer, joining the Senior Executive Team; Paul Whitehead becomes SEVP, Global Corporate Services. Concurrently, Group Head and Chief Operating Officer Taylan Turan departs TD. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated. Watch for follow-on 8-K/6-K disclosure, any severance or successor COO appointment, and signals on strategy, AI and digital-assets execution risk.
